body: Binding owner clarification: only the actual Sherlock video files are non-shareable. Recall transcripts and every other Sherlock-derived or ancillary artifact may be stored and shared. Chief disposition: reject any review hold that requires a new REB/IRB basis for Sherlock participant recall prose or otherwise restores a corpus-wide BBC, consent, or aggregate-only restriction. Keep provenance, exact source/transform/timebase, semantic-authority, uncertainty, anti-circularity, and ordinary artifact-admission courts. This records project policy and does not purport to adjudicate third-party law.
